meta.name: Our Universe
meta.description: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hyun-jin and Tae-hyung are at odds from the moment they meet, only to discover that they will soon be in-laws.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The in-laws who have been at odds are forced to live together with their orphaned nephew, Woo-joo.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As they navigate caring for Woo-joo, Tae-hyung makes an irresistible proposition to Hyun-jin and proposes cohabitating for a month.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Hyun-jin and Tae-hyung's relationship deepens, Hyun-jin hides their living arrangement from her first love, Yoon-seong.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Yoon-seong discovers Hyun-jin's secret, Tae-hyung learns that Yoon-seong was her first love.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tae-hyung gets assigned to work with Hyun-jin and Yoon-seong, while Hyun-jin learns of Tae-hyung's true feelings.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tae-hyung is shaken by the sudden appearance of his estranged father. Meanwhile, Hyun-jin struggles at work.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Hyun-jin finds herself torn between Yoon-seong and Tae-hyung.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Having learned the truth about his past, Tae-hyung decides to leave Hyun-jin and Woo-joo for their safety.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As Hyun-jin grows closer to Yoon-seong, Tae-hyung keeps his distance and decides to move abroad.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Hyun-jin reunites with Tae-hyung after realizing her feelings for him, but their day out is disrupted when Woo-joo goes missing.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: As Woo-joo's guardianship hearing approaches, an unexpected incident threatens to tear the family apart.

meta.slogan: We met not by chance, but by the universe.
